## Purpose
Trunk directory for the `packages/`-style portion of the cross-dir eval fixture; holds the shared library half of a single logical system that is deliberately split across `apps/`, `packages/`, and `scripts/` to stress the systems-registry v2 hypothesis pass.

## Subdirectories
- `shared/` — tiny shared types package (`Event` interface) imported by other fixture packages to exercise cross-package reference resolution. See `shared/README.md`.

## Dependencies / collaborators
- `tools/systems-registry/evals/fixtures/cross-dir/apps/` — consumers of `shared/`'s types; the eval expects v2 to reunify these with `packages/shared/` as one system.
- `tools/systems-registry/evals/fixtures/cross-dir/scripts/` — third leg of the same split system.

## Gotchas
- Fixture, not production — the split across three top-level dirs is the point of the test. Don't "fix" it by consolidating.
